name: env-detach-plan-dense
reason: The frozen band [1.07, 1.21] was refuted: the primary read 0.9733 over six rounds with an interval of [0.9064, 1.0452], entirely below the band. The reading is not a demonstrated regression - it does not separate from the 0.05 floor and its interval includes 1 - but it is flatly incompatible with the prediction of at least seven percent. Both mechanisms demonstrably fired and the search-neutral declaration held on every spread check. A post-mortem profile of the candidate binary shows why the saving did not arrive: the plan engine's collect symbol disappeared but its work relocated into exec_plan, 1.85 to 3.23 percent, for a net of a few tenths; and EcoVec::make_unique moved only from 1.45 to 1.33 percent although the detach fired 200 times per run, which says most of that line was never the node env clone the hypothesis named.

name: queue-eligibility-from-counters
reason: no-gain at the six-round cap. Primary 0.9748, interval [0.8960, 1.0604], not dominant, not separated, band reading inside so not refuted. The mechanism fired on 100 percent of steps (slow_steps 0) and the search-neutral declaration held on every observable, verified additionally by a debug-build oracle over ten million real steps that compared every computed count against an actual walk and never fired. The durable result is the counter: elements_skipped over fast_steps reads 8.57 elements per step on the graded workload, matching 8.27 on the smoke. The average total queue length is about 8.5 runnables, so four filter passes over it were never worth the four percent the band asked for. That number was unknown before this iteration and it prices the rest of the queue-walk family without building any of it.

name: call-frame-one-pass
reason: Six rounds read 1.049, 1.032, 1.098, 1.1373, 0.9454, 1.1317 - five of six above 1, mean 1.0634, microseconds per run 1.0525. At round 4 the session read separated true, lo 1.0051, verdict gain. Round 5 at 0.9454 destroyed dominance permanently and the final verdict is no-gain with lo 0.9884, an interval that includes 1 by a hair. The mechanism is verified: entry_frame_copies reads 1281 per run on an instrumented baseline and 0 on the candidate. The search-neutral declaration held on every observable at the round cap. Filed for the user as split evidence: the primary resolves neither way, the rounds are spent, and no further round can produce a gain because dominance is irrecoverable once a session has gone mixed. MERGED at the user's direction after the split evidence was filed; superproject 66ed777, spur 17e74ad. Post-merge baseline on the perf identity reads 2491.6 against 2300.5 before, about plus 8 percent, an independent check agreeing with the graded direction.
